source: docs/12-quarter-1-reference.md through docs/16-quarter-4-endgame.md; crisis timing from docs/14-quarter-3-reference.md §1

opening_workspace_state.note: Three different kinds of value here, deliberately not blended together. (1) Flow counters that are zero because no quarter has run yet -- revenue, expenses, marketing_spend, leads_generated, customer_acquisition_cost, features_shipped, pipeline_value, deals_closed, fulfillment_cost, incident_count, support_tickets_resolved. These are facts, not defaults. (2) Levels with no stated opening value anywhere in docs/, defaulted to zero and NOT sourced: burn_rate, brand_awareness_score, nps_score, tech_debt_index, quota_attainment_pct, operational_efficiency_score, csat_score, churn_rate. Deliberately not mapped from similarly-named seed scores -- docs/03's Brand Awareness is a 0-100 rating while the model's Brand Score is a small accumulating quantity, and the same scale mismatch applies to the rest, so any mapping would be an invention. (3) runway_months, left null: undefined before any burn has been recorded. finance.cash_balance is absent from this block on purpose -- it comes from the seed's opening_cash_inr at materialisation time, so a company number is never duplicated into scenario config.

notes.only_one_scenario_ships: PulseWear cannot back a second scenario: docs/03-company-load-state.md never states 9 constants the chain needs (see tests/engines/test_quarter_company_agnostic.py::TestPulseWearCannotRunYet and the P0 baseline conflict in docs/10-implementation-gaps.md). Shipping a pulsewear scenario would produce a company that 500s on its first lock, so it is withheld rather than shipped broken.
notes.crisis_wiring: crisis_quarter/crisis_scenario are consumed by services/quarter_run_service.py::run_quarter, which builds a CrisisEvent on the crisis quarter and hands it to compute_quarter; all four scenarios A-D are implemented in app/engines/crisis.py. crisis_scenario is null here on purpose -- that makes the branch assigned deterministically per company (SHA-256-seeded, so a replay lands on the same scenario), rather than pinning one for every company on this scenario.
notes.modifiers_are_legacy: The four modifiers belong to the percentage-influence matrix model in app/engines/legacy_matrix/, which is not wired into run_quarter(). They are materialised so that path stays instantiable, not because the 22-line chain reads them -- it has no modifier stage at all.
